name: Wahoo Costera
address: Av. Costera Miguel Alemán 44, Costa Azul

tagline.es: Barra de mar moderna sobre la Costera
tagline.en: Modern seafood bar on the Costera

specialty: Signature aguachiles, tuna tostadas and zarandeado octopus tacos in a stylish Costera dining room.

photo_notes.cover: Stylish modern seafood restaurant on Acapulco's Costera, warm wood and rope details, open dining room with tropical plants and evening lights.
photo_notes.s1: Aguachile with raw and cured shrimp, tuna, octopus and clam in dark chiltepin sauce, pickled red onion and avocado in a wide stone bowl.
photo_notes.s2: Crisp tostada topped with fresh tuna slices, chipotle avocado mayo, ponzu, pickled onion and sesame seeds.
photo_notes.s3: Flour tortilla taco with charred zarandeado octopus, melted cheese, guacamole and pickled onion.
photo_notes.s4: Braised octopus tentacles with grilled vegetables, white rice and guacamole on a dark plate.
